summary: Code quality is solid (types, module organization, error handling), but deliverable is incomplete and non-functional. Critical gaps: fixture directories (fixtures/case1/, case2/) referenced by workflow & harness are missing; project setup files (package.json, tsconfig.json, .actrc) copied by harness don't exist; workflow omits required actionlint validation step (task requires `actionlint .github/workflows/...` to run). Hardcoded expectations in act harness ("41 pass") are brittle. Without fixtures and setup files, cannot execute workflow or validate with act. As shipped, this would fail immediately.
